appSlogan: A slogan explaining the app informally in a few words.
whatIsAppName: Title for the section introducing the app, asking 'What is {APP_NAME}?'. {APP_NAME} is replaced with the app's name, e.g., 'AmpMod'.
appShortDescription: Shorter version of appDescription. {APP_NAME} is replaced with the app's name.
appDescription: Paragraph describing what the app is and its capabilities, including that it's block-based and built on Scratch/TurboWarp. {APP_NAME} is replaced with the app's name.
notJustScratch: Title emphasizing that the app is more than just Scratch, using {APP_NAME} dynamically. {APP_NAME} is replaced with the app's name.
appConvenience: Paragraph explaining the convenience features of the app and its usability for various project types. {APP_NAME} is replaced with the app's name.
visitForums: Button or link text pointing to the app's community forums.
visitWiki: Button or link text pointing to the app's wiki/documentation.
forProgrammers: Subheading describing features targeted at programmers.
jsCompile: Feature description explaining that {APP_NAME} compiles projects to JavaScript for better performance. {APP_NAME} is replaced with the app's name.
arraysFeature: Feature description about creating and managing arrays/complex lists.
extensionsFeature: Feature description about the additional unsandboxed extensions provided by {APP_NAME}. {APP_NAME} is replaced with the app's name.
forArtists: Subheading describing features targeted at artists and animators.
newFonts: Feature description about new fonts available in {APP_NAME} for costumes and backdrops. {APP_NAME} is replaced with the app's name.
roundedRectangle: Feature description for the rounded rectangle tool.
customFonts: Feature description explaining that custom fonts can be loaded from system fonts or font files.
footer.heading.about: Heading for the 'About' section in the footer.
footer.heading.community: Heading for the 'Community' section in the footer.
footer.heading.resources: Heading for the 'Resources' section in the footer.
footer.heading.legal: Heading for the 'Legal' section in the footer.
amp.footer.copyright: Copyright notice including year and app name. {year} and {APP_NAME} are replaced dynamically. {freeSoftware} becomes a link to the open-source licence.
amp.footer.copyright.freeSoftware: Part of the amp.footer.copyright phrase describing that the software is free and open-source.
amp.footer.disclaimer: Disclaimer stating {APP_NAME} is not affiliated with Scratch or TurboWarp. Links and support actions are replaced dynamically.
amp.footer.disclaimer.supportScratch: Text that links to a Scratch Foundation donation page.
tw.footer.faq: Label for the FAQ page link in the footer.
tw.footer.blog: Label for the blog link in the footer.
amp.onScratch: Label for a link to {APP_NAME}'s forum topic on Scratch.
tw.topicButton: Label for the forums button linking to {APP_NAME} discussion forums.
tw.footer.wiki: Label for the wiki link in the footer.
tw.footer.credits: Label for the credits page link in the footer.
tw.footer.extensions: Label for the extension gallery page link in the footer.
tw.footer.manual: Label for the manual/documentation link in the footer.
tw.code: Label for the source code link.
amp.production: Label for the stable build version of the app.
amp.canary: Label for the canary (experimental) build version of the app.
tw.footer.parameters: Label for the URL parameters documentation link in the footer.
tw.privacy: Label for the privacy policy page link.
